roleTitle: Finance Operations Analyst, E-commerce Fulfilment Software
jobDescription: The e-commerce fulfilment software vendor bills merchants per order and pays out carrier costs it has advanced. The Finance Operations Analyst owns the monthly merchant billing run, holds approval authority for billing credits within a delegated limit, leads the billing review with account management, and is accountable to the head of finance operations for billing accuracy. The billing run covers about 600 merchants on per-order pricing, and the role works with account management, collections and the finance systems team.
requirements: Owns the monthly merchant billing run and holds approval authority for billing credits within a delegated limit.
Maintains the billing rules and merchant rate cards in the billing system.
Leads the monthly billing review with account management and records decisions.
Coordinates billing disputes with account management and collections and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions after each billing run.

evidence.text: Owned the monthly merchant billing run for the fulfilment platform for nearly three years, approving billing credits under my delegated limit of 15,000 per merchant per month in the billing system and referring larger credits to the head of finance operations.
Maintained the billing rules and merchant rate cards in the billing system, logging each rate-card change with the contract amendment reference.
Led the monthly billing review with account management, deciding which disputed invoices were held and recording the outcomes in the review record.

Coordinated billing disputes with account management and collections, recording that account management owned the merchant conversation and collections owned dunning while I owned the billing decision.
Responsibilities included billing-run ownership, credit approvals within limit, rule and rate-card maintenance and the billing review for the fulfilment platform over about three years.
Work sample: the credit approval log showing approvals under the candidate's user id and the billing review record for one month, with the billing system's run identifiers as a verification trail.
Reference call with the former head of finance operations: confirmed the candidate owned the billing run, held the 15,000 credit limit and led the monthly review; confirmed employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate can attend a billing-process walkthrough on site; notice period is one month.

gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented: credits within the 15,000 limit and the billing review; larger credits went to the head of finance operations.
